profile.name: The BIG YANKEY
profile.school: Guilford Park High School (GPHS Panthers, Howard County, MD - HCPSS)
profile.career_goal: Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (D.O.) - Holistic Medicine & Reducing Maternal Healthcare Disparities
profile.essay_theme: From Childhood Medical Distrust to Osteopathic Physician Championing Health Equity

colleges.name: University of Maryland, College Park
colleges.advantage: Flagship state university; top Biological Sciences pre-med advising. 100% full tuition covered when paired with MHEC Guaranteed Access Grant.

colleges.name: Towson University
colleges.advantage: Premier Maryland healthcare pipeline with clinical rotations at Greater Baltimore Medical Center and St. Joseph Medical Center. Automatic Provost scholarship review.

colleges.name: Drexel University
colleges.advantage: World-class cooperative education (co-op) program. CCMA credential allows 1,000+ hours of paid clinical hospital employment before applying to D.O. medical schools.

colleges.name: Loyola University Maryland
colleges.advantage: 85%+ acceptance rate into medical schools from pre-health committee. Jesuit focus on cura personalis (care for the whole person) aligns directly with Osteopathic philosophy.

colleges.name: Morgan State University
colleges.advantage: Historic Maryland HBCU; NIH ASCEND biomedical research center and planned new College of Osteopathic Medicine. Massive merit packages for 4.3 W GPA & BSU leadership.

colleges.name: Johns Hopkins University (JHU)
colleges.advantage: World #1 medical research university. 100% need-met, loan-free Bloomberg financial aid packages. Groundbreaking public health courses in Baltimore healthcare equity.

scholarships.name: The Gates Scholarship
scholarships.strategy: Phase 1 is just the questionnaire, don't stress the essays yet. Flex your 4.3 GPA, CCMA cert, and BSU president role. Full cost of attendance ride covering tuition, dorm, food, and books.

scholarships.name: Coca-Cola Scholars Program
scholarships.strategy: Zero essays in round 1! Literally just drop your transcript, BSU community service hours, and NHS stuff. Takes 1.5 hours max. Apply before Sept 30!

scholarships.name: UMD President's & Banneker/Key Scholarships
scholarships.amount: Up to Full Tuition, Room & Board ($120,000)
scholarships.strategy: NO SEPARATE ESSAY! Just submit UMD Early Action before Nov 1 and you're automatically considered for the full-ride Banneker/Key and President's scholarships.

scholarships.name: Towson Provost & Honors College Scholarships
scholarships.strategy: Automatic review when you submit Towson EA by Nov 1. Locks in priority review for the Towson Honors College and allied health pre-med cohort.

scholarships.name: Jack Kent Cooke College Scholarship
scholarships.strategy: Submits through Common App. Talk about your CCMA patient care, turning doctor distrust into your DO vision, and high grades. Up to $55k a year ($220k total).

scholarships.name: Elks Most Valuable Student (MVS) Competition
scholarships.strategy: Judged by our local Howard County / Columbia-Ellicott City Elks Lodge (#2585). Emphasize your ethical leadership as BSU Co-Pres and commitment to community health.

scholarships.name: Drexel Liberty Scholars (100% Tuition)
scholarships.strategy: Free tuition bag! Submit Drexel EA by Nov 15. Covers 100% of your tuition for underrepresented students with top academic credentials.

scholarships.name: National Honor Society (NHS) Scholarship
scholarships.strategy: Exclusive to active NHS members. Quick essay on the 4 pillars (Scholarship, Service, Leadership, Character) and verification from our Guilford Park HS chapter.

scholarships.name: Ron Brown Scholar Program
scholarships.strategy: The biggest national award for Black high school seniors ($40,000). Dec 1 early deadline unlocks extra corporate funding. Submit your personal statement and rec letters.

scholarships.name: UMBC Meyerhoff Scholars Program
scholarships.strategy: The #1 pipeline in the country for Black pre-med students. Full ride + research stipend. Put in the priority nomination by Dec 1.

scholarships.name: Burger King Foundation Scholars
scholarships.strategy: Window caps at 50,000 applicants nationwide so jump on this as soon as it opens Oct 15. Free money for college, 1 hour quick win.

scholarships.name: Equitable Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.strategy: Detail your BSU initiatives at Guilford Park High School and your clinical dedication as a CCMA. Awards $5k to $20k for community changemakers.

scholarships.name: AvaCare Medical Healthcare Scholarship
scholarships.strategy: Super easy. Just write a short 350-word story about an act of patient empathy from your CCMA clinical hours. $1k for 1 hour of work.

scholarships.name: Jackie Robinson Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.strategy: Connects minority leadership with athletics. Highlight your lacrosse goalie grit and CCMA patient advocacy. Up to $35k + 4 years of mentoring.

scholarships.name: Foot Locker Scholar Athletes Program
scholarships.strategy: Write about being the last line of defense in the lacrosse goal and how protecting teammates translates to protecting vulnerable patients. $20k award.

scholarships.name: UNCF Healthcare Workforce Diversity Scholarships
scholarships.strategy: Corporate pre-med endowments (AbbVie, CVS, P&G) specifically for Black students entering medical and healthcare careers. Drop your UNCF profile.

scholarships.name: Columbia (MD) Alumnae Chapter Delta Sigma Theta Scholarship
scholarships.strategy: Howard County only and you're ALREADY in Delta Scholars! This is our local bag right here. Flex your BSU leadership and pre-med hustle. $2k–$5k.
requirements: African American Senior attending Howard County High School

scholarships.name: Dell Scholars Program
scholarships.strategy: They care about grit and resilience over test scores. Flex your NHS, BSU, dual enrollment, and CCMA cert. $20,000 + a free laptop.

scholarships.name: Horatio Alger State & National Scholarships
scholarships.strategy: Specifically for seniors who overcame real challenges. Connect your childhood distrust of medicine to turning that pain into becoming an empathetic DO.

scholarships.name: Cynthia E. Morgan Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.strategy: Exclusively for Maryland students going into medicine or healthcare. Literally made for future pre-med students. 1 hour application.

scholarships.name: Howard P. Rawlings Guaranteed Access (GA) Grant
scholarships.strategy: DO NOT SLEEP ON THIS. Submit FAFSA or MHEC One-App before March 1. If your family income qualifies and you have a 2.5+ GPA (you got 4.3!), the state covers 100% of your tuition at UMD, Towson, or Morgan State. Free college.

scholarships.name: Community Foundation of Howard County (CFHoCo) Scholarships
scholarships.strategy: Exclusively for HCPSS seniors! One application puts you in the running for multiple local endowments in Howard County. With a 4.3 GPA and CCMA cert, you're top of the pile.

scholarships.name: The Pearl Foundation / AKA Iota Lambda Omega Howard County Scholarship
scholarships.strategy: Administered by the Pearl Foundation & AKA Iota Lambda Omega chapter for Howard County seniors. Great match for your 4.3 GPA, BSU leadership, and healthcare dreams.

scholarships.name: PTA Council of Howard County (PTACHC) Senior Scholarship
scholarships.strategy: Local scholarship for HCPSS seniors (Guilford Park HS). Quick application, emphasizes community service and career goals.

scholarships.name: CBC Spouses Education Scholarship
scholarships.strategy: Congressional Black Caucus Foundation awards Black seniors with demonstrated community leadership. Use your BSU Co-Pres record and pre-med mission.

scholarships.name: Central Scholarship (Maryland Pre-Med & Health Fund)
scholarships.strategy: One application puts you in for 50+ Maryland funds, including dedicated pre-med and healthcare endowments. Free money pool.

scholarships.name: Maryland Senatorial & Delegate Scholarships
scholarships.strategy: Direct legislative aid from our District 13 / District 12 (Jessup & Columbia) Senator and Delegates through MDCAPS. High GPA and Guilford Park leadership puts you first in line.

scholarships.name: Alpha Kappa Alpha Educational Advancement Foundation
scholarships.strategy: Merit and need awards for minority scholars. Re-use your personal statement emphasizing BSU service and your D.O. pre-med mission.
